title: Standard event envelope
description: The wire envelope every AgentKit runtime produces and every client reduces. Identity fields are what make recovery possible: eventId dedupes, streamEpoch discards a stale tail, and sequenceNumber is gapless within an epoch.

data.description: Event-specific payload. Carried opaquely end to end: a journal must round-trip it byte for byte.

timestamp.description: Unix epoch milliseconds. Zero in frozen fixtures.

sequenceNumber.description: Gapless and monotonic within one streamEpoch, shared by a network run and its agents.

id.description: Suggested durable-publish step id: publish-<seq>:<event>, or publish-e<epoch>-<seq>:<event> once epochs are in use.

eventId.description: Replay-stable identity for one logical event: <runId>:<streamEpoch>:<sequenceNumber>. The client's dedupe key.

streamEpoch.description: Production epoch. A resumed or restarted run increments it and resets sequenceNumber.
